page.overview:
Who is T'Gin-Zu?

{| class="wikitable" style="border-collapse:collapse;" !style="border:1px solid black" colspan=2|Generation 1

T'Gin-Zu was boxed with the Ninja Force Piledriver vehicle in the 1993 series of A Real American Hero toys. ---- Appearance: red face mask and white hood; white shirt with blue shoulder armor; red belt and sash; white pants with white boots

Accessories: black "'92 Storm Shadow" sword.

Notes: The character art shows orange shoulder and boots, with a black facemask. ---- YoJoe.com page/Filecard
